analyses.content: 录音明确说到只有公寓（flat）带有一个由所有房客共用的花园。
你可能会听到房子（house）后面有“一点点空间（a bit of space）”，但录音紧接着否定了那算作花园，同时招待所（hostel）因为是城市开发项目也没有空间建花园，注意听清转折否定。

The properties don't all have gardens, I'm afraid. The house is quite small, not much space around it. It has got a bit of space at the back, but I wouldn't call it a garden. Mm-hmm. The hostel is part of a city development, so there's no space for a garden. But the flat has a communal garden that is shared by all the tenants. I would say that that's very good value for the price.
录音直接指出，每套公寓（flat）的场地内都配套分配了一个车库。
你可能会听到房子（house）附近有车库，但录音强调那些车库是需要“单独租用（rent those separately）”且不一定有空位的，并不包含在住宿本身内。

Have you got a car? Yes. Um, there are garages round the corner from the house. Ah, but you have to rent those separately, and they might not be available. Oh. But each flat is allotted a garage in the grounds as part of the deal. The hostel doesn't have the space, I'm afraid.
录音明确提到，只有这栋房子（house）是装有警报器（alarmed）的。
你可能会听到公寓和招待所有对讲机（intercom）觉得也挺安全，但题目明确问的是“警报系统（alarm system）”，千万别把它们混为一谈。

I guess you might also want to know about security as well. Mm. Uh, the house is the only one which is alarmed. The flats and the hostel are accessed through a main door, which has an intercom for visitors, so they're quite safe.
录音指出房子（house）里的家具和配件在上一任房客走后刚刚全部被替换过（replaced），也就是新家具。
你可能会把公寓（flat）家具“看起来很现代（modern-looking）”或者“状况良好”等同于“全新（new）”，但录音其实也提到了它们是有使用痕迹的（considering the use it's had）。

Now, they're all furnished. Mm-hmm. The stuff in the flat's quite modern-looking, which most people like, and it's in quite good condition, considering the use it's had. Mm. All the furniture and fittings in the house have just been replaced after the last tenants left, so they'll be in excellent condition. And the furniture in the hostel is okay. It's about what you'd expect, really.
录音说我们现在在主街（High Street）的住宿代理处，而“直接在我们正对面（Directly opposite us）”的就是银行。
刚开局你可能还没在图上找到起始点（agency），如果没有第一时间锁定代理处并听清“正对面（opposite）”这个方位词，就会随便乱猜一个字母。
Uh, right. Um, we're here in the accommodation agency on the High Street facing north. Mm-hmm. Directly opposite us is the bank. Okay?
顺着路朝西街（West Street）走，房子在游泳池旁边隔着一栋建筑（next but one）的位置，且正好在到达西街之前。
你可能会一听到“游泳池（swimming pool）”就着急选了紧挨着它的H，忽略了“next but one（下一个再隔一个）”的表达，要越过紧挨着的建筑选I才对。

If you stay on this side of the road and walk towards West Street, the house is not that far. It's next but one to the swimming pool, just before West Street. It's very convenient because it's near the shops.
招待所位于西街（West Street）和圣安妮路（St. Anne's Road）的拐角处，并且靠近环岛（roundabout）。
你可能会在西街上到处乱找，但只要紧紧抓住“路口拐角（corner）”和“环岛附近”这两个具体的双重参照物，就不会选错地点。
The hostel is on the corner of West Street and St. Anne's Road, near the roundabout. It's not a very wonderful building, but it's nice and close to the college.
沿着西街（West Street）往市中心走，建筑就在左侧第一个转弯处（first turning on the left）之前的拐角上。
地图题最怕丢方向，如果你没跟紧“左边（left）”或者没注意到是“转弯前（before the turning）”，很可能会顺着大路看错边或者越过了路口选错。

The flat is a bit of a walk, but it's in very nice surroundings. To get to the flat, you go down West Street towards the center of the city, and the building is on the corner, just before the first turning on the left. Mm-hmm.
沿着主街（High Street）走，向右转进入西街（West Street），邮局就在你的右手边。
当你脑补自己右转进西街后，你面对的方向已经变了，此时你的“右边”在地图上对应的是马路上方，很容易没转过弯而选成对面的B。

Although we're a bit outside the city center, the facilities aren't bad. There's a post office just round the corner from here. You go down the High Street and turn right into West Street, and it's on your right. Mm-hmm.
从起点代理处（agency）沿着路往东走几米就是巴士站，并且“不需要过马路（don't even need to cross the road）”。
听到“往东走（going east）”你可能大方向看对了，但如果没有仔细听清“不用过马路”，你很可能会选成街对面的那个错误选项。
Or if you want to go to the city center, you could get the bus from here, just a few meters down the road from the agency, going east. You don't even need to cross the road.
